name: Wings of Flying
description: A cloak of feathered panels that unfold into great wings.
body:
## What they do

Speak the word as an action and the cloak becomes a pair of wings for an hour, or until you speak again. Folded, they cannot open again for 1d12 hours.

features.name: Wings
features.text: The wings last an hour and then cannot be used again for 1d12 hours.
